actions: Mina returns trays and enters the hot greenhouse
consequences: Establishes the afternoon and Mina’s errand
prose_obligations: Name the community greenhouse and the heat
scenes.notes: Opening and the initial discovery are combined in one executable encounter.

actions: Notice drooping leaves and cracked soil
consequences: Mina wants to protect the seedlings
prose_obligations: Make the seedlings’ need legible

actions: Recall the neighborhood planting day
consequences: Gives Mina a personal reason to act
prose_obligations: Show ordinary responsibility, not a grand quest

actions: Read the note authorizing use and asking for a rinse
consequences: Borrowing is permitted and return has a purpose
prose_obligations: Keep Ivo the owner of the can
scenes.notes: The note is established in the opening; the handoff is the executable borrow scene.

actions: Take the blue can carefully
consequences: Mina holds Ivo’s can
prose_obligations: Distinguish custody from ownership

actions: Test the awkward handle
consequences: Shows the can is useful but borrowed
prose_obligations: Keep the object’s handling plausible
scenes.notes: Consolidated with the handoff; no separate event is required.

actions: Read the instruction to keep cells evenly moist
consequences: Mina understands how to avoid flooding roots
prose_obligations: Make the advice practical and brief

actions: Free its spare band
consequences: A band can seal the can seam if needed
prose_obligations: Do not make the band appear if the vignette is omitted
scenes.notes: Reading the marker and finding its band are one local play.

actions: Ask Rosa about water and shade
consequences: Rosa gives advice without taking over
prose_obligations: Give Rosa a distinct, practical voice

actions: Point out the screen and leave air above leaves
consequences: A screen can provide strong shade
prose_obligations: Do not place the screen unless it is available and advice was heard
scenes.notes: Directions are spoken in the vignette; actually placing the screen remains a later action.

actions: Fill from the shared tank
consequences: Tank water enters the can
prose_obligations: Conserve water across the action

actions: See water escape through the split seam
consequences: An unsealed can loses one unit
prose_obligations: Show the leak only when the parameter says it exists

prerequisites: The can leaks and the label band is available
actions: Bind the seam with the found band
consequences: The water loss is prevented; the band must later be returned
prose_obligations: Do not give a band to routes that skipped the label vignette

actions: Pour into seedling cells rather than flooding the bench
consequences: Delivered water depends on supply, heat, dryness, and leakage
prose_obligations: Let a shortage remain a real complication
scenes.notes: Filling, sealing when possible, and pouring form one scene with separate atomic events.

actions: Observe the soil darken or remain short of water
consequences: Sets the persistent seedling condition used by shade and ending guards
prose_obligations: Do not claim instant full growth

prerequisites: Watering is complete; Rosa gave directions; cloth exists
actions: Draw the screen down above the tray
consequences: The seedlings receive strong shade
prose_obligations: Leave airflow and maintain the screen’s location
scenes.notes: Fetching and hanging the screen are consolidated into one enacted action.

prerequisites: Watering is complete but the screen route is unavailable
actions: Move the tray into the wall’s shadow
consequences: The tray is sheltered but not fully protected
prose_obligations: Keep the tray’s new location persistent

prerequisites: Water and shade have been applied
actions: Assess whether the tray is stable or only sheltered
consequences: Selects a compatible ending
prose_obligations: Avoid claiming plants instantly grow
scenes.notes: Condition assessment is expressed in the shade scene and enforced again by the ending guard.

actions: Rinse the can, return it, and replace a used band
consequences: Ivo’s property is useful again and custody is restored
prose_obligations: Return usefulness as well as possession

prerequisites: Can is returned; tray condition is known
actions: Confirm stable seedlings or root viable tips from a sheltered tray
consequences: Completes either successful protection or an honest salvage
prose_obligations: End with a completed, emotionally legible outcome
scenes.notes: The reference story follows the stable branch. The executable cuttings ending is an alternate, complete response to insufficient water or shade.
